The Geographical Information Science Research Group (GIScRG) of the Royal Geographical Society with IBG (RGS-IBG) is pleased to invite applications for the **2026 Postgraduate Dissertation Award (Master's Level)**.

The award recognises outstanding postgraduate research in Geographic Information Science (GIScience), spatial analysis, spatial modelling and geocomputation.

## Eligibility

- Dissertations must be at Master's level and have been approved or awarded between **1 January and 31 December 2026**.
- Dissertations must be of **Distinction standard**.
- Research should address topics relating to GIScience, spatial analysis, spatial modelling or geocomputation.
- Dissertations must not have been submitted previously to the same award competition.
- A maximum of **two applications per department** will be accepted from higher education institutions in the UK and the Republic of Ireland.

## Application Requirements

Applications must include:

1. A PDF copy of the dissertation.
2. An endorsement letter or email from the Director of Postgraduate Programme or a nominated institutional representative.

Applications must be submitted by the student's institution, through the Director of Postgraduate Programme or a nominated representative, with the student's knowledge.

## Submission Deadline

**31 December 2026**

Please email all application materials to:

**Dr Xiao Li** (Prize Manager)

[xiao-shaw.li@polyu.edu.hk](mailto:xiao-shaw.li@polyu.edu.hk)

## Awards

- **Winner:** £100 and a one-year RGS-IBG Associate Fellowship.
- **Runner-up:** £50 and a one-year RGS-IBG Associate Fellowship.

We encourage eligible students and their institutions to participate and showcase their research contributions to GIScience.
